uutiset.t: US Funding for Trump-Linked Bosnian Gas Pipeline Is in Jeopardy
uutiset.s: US federal funding of $2.3 billion in energy and airport infrastructure projects in Bosnia-Herzegovina are in jeopardy as government development banks in Washington distanced themselves from the plan.

uutiset.t: Clampdown on China Chip Loophole; Nvidia Earnings Countdown
uutiset.s: Selling pressure on US technology stocks eased ahead of Nvidia Corp.’s much-anticipated results that could prove as pivotal for the company as for the broader artificial-intelligence trade. uutiset.t: Nvidia’s Earnings Come at a Time of Mounting Tech Turmoil
uutiset.s: Stock has plunged 35% from October peak, dragging Nasdaq lower.

uutiset.t: Cash-Strapped Indian States Risk Infrastructure Push, Study Says
uutiset.s: Indian states are being squeezed between rising spending commitments and weaker-than-expected revenues, leaving less money for infrastructure at a time when Prime Minister Narendra Modi is counting on investment to sustain rapid economic growth.

uutiset.t: BofA Survey Shows Investors Cut Tech Exposure by Most Since 2006
uutiset.s: Investor optimism around the global AI boom is fading with fund managers slashing exposure to technology stocks by the most in two decades, according to a poll by Bank of America Corp.

uutiset.t: Home Depot Names McPhail CEO as Decker Returns as Chairman
uutiset.s: Home Depot Inc. said Richard McPhail will take over as chief executive officer from Ted Decker, who is returning from medical leave to serve as chairman.

uutiset.t: UniCredit Sees Up to €2 Billion Value from Generali Cooperation
uutiset.s: UniCredit SpA sees the potential to unlock €1.5 billion ($1.65 billion) to €2 billion of value through closer cooperation with Italian insurer Assicurazioni Generali SpA, Chief Executive Officer Andrea Orcel said.

uutiset.t: The Latest Longevity Hack Is Surprisingly Low-Tech
uutiset.s: The latest longevity trend isn’t cryotherapy chambers or $250,000 clubs, but a competition that measures strength, balance and brain health. Jen Murphy takes us behind the scenes of the first Super Age Games. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: US Gas Pump Price Hits 8-Month Low to Ease Inflation Worries
uutiset.s: US gasoline pump prices fell to the lowest since mid-March following a broader decline in oil markets this month, in a sign that inflationary pressures from the Iran war are beginning to ease.

uutiset.t: Unloved 30-Year Bond Is a Surprise Hit With UK Retail Investors
uutiset.s: Retail investors are piling into long-dated UK bonds that bore the brunt of this year’s selloff, locking in rates above 5% and the chance of tax-free capital gains if prices rise.

uutiset.t: Deutsche Bank Leak Shows Payments Linked to Epstein
uutiset.s: Deutsche Bank dropped after the Financial Times reported the firm had processed $582 million of suspicious payments linked to the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. uutiset.t: Turkish Households Buckle Under Gold-Price Slide, Funds Crisis
uutiset.s: Falling gold prices and an investment-industry crisis are amplifying a slowdown in Turkish domestic demand, reversing a wealth effect that helped sustain household spending in recent years.

uutiset.t: European Stocks Fall as US Chip Curbs Ignite Fresh AI Selloff
uutiset.s: European stocks slid as concerns over the artificial-intelligence trade swept markets ahead of results from Nvidia Corp., after the US moved to impose sweeping new restrictions on China’s access to high-end AI chips.

uutiset.t: European Gas Fluctuates as Traders Weigh Iran Mediation Efforts
uutiset.s: European natural gas fluctuated as traders weighed the outlook for fresh efforts to mediate the conflict between the US and Iran.

uutiset.t: Canadian Funds Join Nordic Capital in €3 Billion Cary Deal
uutiset.s: CVC Capital Partners Plc is selling its stake in vehicle glass repair company Cary Group to two of Canada’s largest pension funds and Nordic Capital, which is set to reinvest in the business.
